text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Representative Exchange Race and 
the selection of Japan's representatives 
fast approaching, Tap Dance City's passion 
for her dream burns even hotter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A free and fun life unbound by common 
sense— chasing her dream of becoming the 
world's best for that very purpose, she 
finds those around her cheering her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment she entered the Trainer's 
office, she immediately proposed a match 
against <chrname> in the Representative Exchange 
Match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A clash of wills, each striving to be the 
best in the world. The time for the 
showdown was drawing near to decide who 
was truly worthy of representing Japan.
